title: Tech Electronics
description:
Consulting | St. Louis, Missouri, United States | Tech Electronics specializes in integrated building technology solutions that enhance safety, communication, and operational efficiency for various industries including healthcare, education, and government. Their extensive product offerings include fire and life safety systems, security solutions, and advanced communication technologies tailored to meet the unique needs of their clients. The company provides a range of services such as fire and security monitoring, inspections, and technology as a service to ensure optimal system performance. With multiple locations across the Midwest, Tech Electronics is committed to delivering responsive service and customized solutions to its clients. 
The company headquarters is located in 6437 Manchester Avenue, St. Louis, MO 63139, United States.
